about: THE ONE PLACE for the instance list of perf-gemma-swe32 (the 32 x 5 rerun): the same 32 instances, in the same order, as perf-swe16's formal runs (jobs 3357655 / 3357977 / 3360287 / 3363871 / 3364292): every plan's server registers these tasks in this order and the agents start them in this order, at most 16 at once, refilled as they finish. The sealed statements are tasks/tasks-pool.json, byte-identical to perf-swe16's tbench-built file (SHA-256 e4835924...). To change the list: edit `instances`, seal matching statements (build.py --reuse-bundle --tasks <file> or --tasks-subset <file>), re-deploy the tbench half (its manifest names this file), run local_validation.ps1.
source: perf-swe16/tasks/swe16-tasks.json (the first 32 SWE-bench Verified instances, test split, dataset order).
